title: Read summaries, page deliberately, then select full detail
when: A QA plan catalog, session roster, steering report, deployment run or launch history is large
need: Routine replies use concise command-specific projections and pages. JSON envelopes and write replies remain complete. Only oversized registered human reads refuse atomically above 28,000 UTF-8 bytes; narrow the read or use --full for complete human detail. Read a message body before acting using its named body read; default message detail previews long bodies and prints short bodies whole. Packet renders list headings and name the full packet read. Deployment lists retain continuation cursors and multi-field get. Run detail defaults to status, stage and member counts with explicit member/blocker recipes. Launch lists default to compact operational/history tables with full launch IDs and cursors; --full restores placement, model and registered-session columns.
surface: CLI help, command results and refusals
recipes: yoke deployment-runs get RUN-ID status current_stage release_lineage
